decisions.reason: The cloud contact centre service extends the firm's established offer and supports its single-provider strategy; with no reported shortfall against aspiration and ample slack in a large, expanding firm, there is no trigger for problemistic search or withdrawal.

The call number routing platform sits close to the core voice business and has its own web page, which signals commitment; with no evidence of underperformance and low carrying costs, keeping it is the satisficing choice.
